protocol_extension: RFC 6026 corrected INVITE transaction / RFC 3261 timing profile
title: UAS 2xx retransmission starts at T1
natural_language: 在默认 T1=500 ms 的 profile 下，UAS 发送 INVITE 2xx 后，若此前未收到匹配 ACK，第一次 2xx 重传不得早于 500 ms，并应在 500 ms 时发生。
standard_excerpt: The interval starts at T1 seconds and doubles for each retransmission until it reaches T2 seconds.
time_source: RFC 3261 default T1=500 ms, used by RFC 6026 section 8.1

ap_definitions.uas_2xx_sent: tsip_transac_ist_Proceeding_2_Accepted_X_2xx sends the first 2xx and schedules Timer X for the correlated INVITE transaction
ap_definitions.uas_2xx_retransmitted: Timer X callback passes the saved 2xx response to tsip_transac_send for the same transaction
ap_definitions.uas_2xx_ack_received: the Accepted-state ACK callback receives the matching ACK and cancels Timer X

correlation_key: top Via branch + Call-ID + CSeq number/method + From/To tags; identifiers remain event fields, not AP names
projection_rule: correlate one INVITE dialog/transaction first, then project Timer X send/ACK events; omit unrelated transactions
instrumentation_timing: emit uas_2xx_sent after the initial tsip_transac_send and Timer X schedule; emit uas_2xx_retransmitted immediately after the Timer X callback send; merge a same-timestamp ACK cancellation atomically
review_question: 确认实验 profile 固定 RFC 3261 默认 T1=500 ms，且区分首发 2xx 与 Timer X 重传。
limitations: RFC 6026规定的是 UAS core 的端到端 2xx 可靠性；Doubango 将其作为 server transaction 的 Timer X 扩展实现。

protocol_extension: RFC 6026 corrected INVITE transaction / RFC 3261 timing profile
title: UAS 2xx second interval doubles
natural_language: 第一次 2xx 重传周期完成后，下一次重传间隔由 T1 加倍为 1000 ms，除非期间收到匹配 ACK。
standard_excerpt: The interval starts at T1 seconds and doubles for each retransmission until it reaches T2 seconds.
time_source: RFC 6026 doubling rule with RFC 3261 default T1=500 ms

ap_definitions.uas_2xx_first_cycle_completed: Timer X has produced the first retransmission and its timeout has been doubled for the correlated INVITE transaction
ap_definitions.uas_2xx_retransmitted: Timer X callback passes the saved 2xx to the transport for the same transaction
ap_definitions.uas_2xx_ack_received: the matching ACK is received while Accepted and Timer X is cancelled

correlation_key: top Via branch + Call-ID + CSeq number/method + From/To tags
projection_rule: derive cycle index from per-transaction Timer X state, then project only the correlated INVITE transaction
instrumentation_timing: emit cycle-completed after the first callback send and timeout doubling; emit retransmission after subsequent callback sends
review_question: 确认 cycle-completed AP 由适配器的事务局部计数器产生。
limitations: 这是默认 T1 profile 的具体实例；改变 T1 时必须等比例重写公式和 trace。

protocol_extension: RFC 6026 corrected INVITE transaction / RFC 3261 timing profile
title: UAS 2xx retransmission interval is capped at T2
natural_language: 2xx 重传间隔达到默认 T2=4000 ms 后不得继续加倍；未收到匹配 ACK 时，后续重传间隔保持 4000 ms。
standard_excerpt: The interval starts at T1 seconds and doubles for each retransmission until it reaches T2 seconds.
time_source: RFC 3261 default T2=4 s, used by RFC 6026 section 8.1

ap_definitions.uas_2xx_interval_at_t2: the correlated Timer X retransmission state has reached the T2 cap
ap_definitions.uas_2xx_retransmitted: the saved 2xx is sent again for that INVITE transaction
ap_definitions.uas_2xx_ack_received: a matching ACK cancels further 2xx retransmissions

correlation_key: top Via branch + Call-ID + CSeq number/method + From/To tags
projection_rule: maintain the raw timeout and capped expected timeout as transaction adapter fields; project a fixed AP alphabet
instrumentation_timing: emit interval-at-T2 from the per-transaction retransmission adapter when expected min(2*interval,T2)=T2; emit each timer callback send
review_question: 确认把该条作为已知实现偏差 oracle：源码直接左移 timeout，未显式执行 min(...,T2)。
limitations: 源码位置是潜在不符合点而非符合实现；性质来自标准，适合检测间隔超过 T2 的行为。

title: ACK stops UAS 2xx retransmissions
natural_language: UAS 收到与 2xx 匹配的 ACK 后，该响应的周期性重传必须停止。
standard_excerpt: Response retransmissions cease when an ACK request for the response is received.

ap_definitions.uas_2xx_ack_received: matching ACK reaches the Accepted-state handler and Timer X is cancelled
ap_definitions.uas_2xx_retransmitted: Timer X callback sends the saved 2xx for the same INVITE transaction

correlation_key: Call-ID + CSeq + From/To tags, with ACK matched to the accepted INVITE dialog and response
projection_rule: correlate ACK before projection; keep the trace through transaction/dialog destruction so absence after ACK is meaningful
instrumentation_timing: emit ACK atomically after correlation and immediately before/with Timer X cancellation; emit retransmit on callback send
review_question: 确认 trace adapter 在 ACK 后继续保留该事务投影直到观察窗结束。
limitations: 无界性质依赖有限词末尾语义；实验必须给出足够长且明确关闭的观察窗。

title: Timer L terminates the Accepted server transaction
natural_language: INVITE server transaction 发送 2xx 并进入 Accepted 后，Timer L 设置为 64*T1；默认 profile 下事务不得早于 32000 ms 终止，并在 32000 ms 终止。
standard_excerpt: The state machine MUST transition to the Accepted state and set Timer L to 64*T1.
time_source: RFC 6026 64*T1 with RFC 3261 default T1=500 ms

ap_definitions.server_accepted_entered: server FSM takes Proceeding--send 2xx-->Accepted and schedules Timer L
ap_definitions.server_transaction_terminated: server FSM takes Accepted--Timer L-->Terminated for the correlated transaction

correlation_key: top Via branch + Call-ID + CSeq number/method
projection_rule: one INVITE server transaction per projection; merge state transition and timer scheduling at the same timestamp
instrumentation_timing: emit accepted-entered after Timer L scheduling; emit terminated on the Timer L FSM transition before destruction
review_question: 确认默认 T1 profile 和 server transaction destruction hook。
limitations: RFC 6026 要求不可仅因响应发送的不可恢复 transport error 丢弃 server state；适配器应把这类早退保留为违反事件。

title: Timer M terminates the Accepted client transaction
natural_language: INVITE client transaction 收到 2xx 并进入 Accepted 后，正常路径的 Timer M 为 64*T1；默认 profile 下应在 32000 ms 终止，只有已观测到的 transport abort 可导致提前终止。
standard_excerpt: It MUST transition to the Accepted state, pass the 2xx response to the TU, and set Timer M to 64*T1.
time_source: RFC 6026 64*T1 with RFC 3261 default T1=500 ms

ap_definitions.client_accepted_entered: client FSM receives a matching 2xx in Calling/Proceeding, enters Accepted, and schedules Timer M
ap_definitions.client_transaction_terminated: client FSM enters Terminated from Accepted
ap_definitions.client_transport_abort: latched event/value indicating a correlated unrecoverable client transport error that RFC 6026 permits to discard state early

correlation_key: top Via branch + Call-ID + CSeq number/method + response branch/fork matching
projection_rule: correlate all 2xx branches to the original INVITE client transaction; client_transport_abort is true on the atomic early-termination position
instrumentation_timing: emit accepted-entered after Timer M schedule; emit termination at Timer M transition; atomically tag transport-driven early termination with client_transport_abort
review_question: 确认 transport error 例外在同一 microstep 原子标记，避免把标准允许的提前销毁误报为违反。
limitations: 公式显式容纳 RFC 6026 允许的 client transport-error early discard；若无法观测该原因，应降级为正常路径性质。
